greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu kunye nani nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, sihlangene apha ukukubiza. Nkosi, yiba nenceba kuthi. Kristu, yiba nenceba kuthi. Nkosi, yiba nenceba kuthi.
psalm_response: Khokela mna, Nkosi, endleleni yemithetho yakho.
homily:
Khumbula umzuzu othi cwaka, umfanekiso onokuthi uwubone ngeso lengqondo: uBenjamin Vo ehlezi kwitafile yakhe, ephethe ikhompyutha yakhe, ebonakala engathi ucinga ngento enkulu kakhulu—mhlawumbi uyila ikhowudi entsha okanye ecinga ngendlela indiza i-Boeing 737 ephaphayo ngayo. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukwazi ukuba izinto zisebenza njani. Wayengumfana owayenomdla ongenamida, kodwa ngaphezu kwako konke, wayeyindoda encane eyayiphethe intliziyo ethambileyo, intliziyo eyayisoloko ikulungele ukunika. Khumbula loo mfana owayenoncumo olukhanyisayo, owayesoloko enembeko, owayethanda ukuhamba nehlabathi kunye nosapho lwakhe, kwaye owayesoloko ecinga ngabanye ngaphambi kokuba acinge ngaye.

Namhlanje, kwiNcwadi yeZaci, uThixo usikhumbuza into ebalulekileyo: 'Intliziyo yenkosi ifana nomfula esandleni seNkosi; iyayikhokela apho ithanda khona.' La magama asikhumbuza ukuba ubomi bethu abukho ezandleni zethu kuphela. Busezandleni zikaThixo. Kodwa masime apha. Masithethe inyaniso. Sekuphele iinyanga ezintathu uBen esishiye. Iinyanga ezintathu zokuziva ukuba indlu ithule kakhulu. Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba usizi luyinto enzima, ngakumbi xa ucinga ngaloo mntwana wakho owayekuthanda kakhulu, owayekulalele xa ubalisa amabali akho, owayekuthanda kakhulu njengoba wayekuthanda ukuhamba nawe, Ryan. Usizi aluhambi ngokwekhalenda. Niyazibuza ukuba kwenzeke ntoni. Niyazibuza ukuba kutheni lo mfana owayephila ngothando, owayephila ngobubele, kufuneka ahambe ngolu hlobo. Niyazibuza ukuba kukhona na eninokukwenza ngcono. Ndicela niphulaphule: Ukugula akulona iphutha lenu. Akukho nto eniyenze ngendlela engalunganga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala. Susa lowo mthwalo wokuzisola egxalabeni lakho. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo. UThixo akathumeli ukugula. Ezinye izinto zenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu, ngaphandle kokuba nabani na enze impazamo. Niyinyaniso, nithandwa nguThixo, kwaye uBen ukhululekile kuyo yonke intlungu.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu uxelelwa ukuba unina nabazalwana bakhe bafuna ukumbona. Kodwa uYesu uthi: 'Umama wam nabazalwana bam ngabo abaliphulaphulayo ilizwi likaThixo, baze balenze.' UYesu usibonisa ukuba ubudlelwane bakhe abupheleli kwigazi, kodwa busekulandeleni uThixo. UBen wayeyimbewu enothando. Wayengumfana owayephila ngothando, kodwa ngoku, ubomi bakhe busikhumbuza ukuba ubomi bethu abupheleli apha emhlabeni. UBen utyalwe emhlabeni ngendlela yomzimba, kodwa uya kuvuka ngendlela yomoya—ngomzimba oqaqambileyo, onamandla, nowonwabileyo phambi koThixo.

Khumbula indlela uBen awayenomsa ngayo, umzekelo xa wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, akazange ayikhuphule ngokoqobo, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe—isipho somntu owayemi elulwini lokuba angazigcineli nto, kodwa anikele ngayo yonke into ayenayo. Lo moya wokunika waba yindlela yakhe yokuphila. UBen wayengumfana onikela ngayo yonke into yakhe. Nani, nikani konke usizi lwenu kuThixo. Musani ukuzama ukuluthwala lodwa. Vumelani uYesu ukuba abe lulwalwa lwenu.

Ryan, mfowethu omncane, uBen uyamthanda. Ungalokothi uzive ungedwa. UBen uyaqhubeka ekukhathalele. Qhubeka uphila ngesibindi, ube ngumfana owayeyiyo—onemfesane, onobubele, nonesibindi. UBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya ngomsebenzi wakhe wothando, njengaloo mthombo wamanzi eCà Mau, olethela ubomi kwabanye. Uthando lwakhe aluzange luphele; lusaqhubeka lugeza umhlaba njengolwandle olukhulu. Nani, Alan noThao, ningayeki ukuthanda. Nithandeke kakhulu nguThixo. UBen wayengumfana onikela ngayo yonke into yakhe. Nani, nikani konke usizi lwenu kuThixo. Musani ukuzama ukuluthwala lodwa. Vumelani uYesu ukuba abe lulwalwa lwenu.

Xa uziva usizi, yithi: 'Nkosi, ndiyakuthanda, kwaye ndiyakuthemba.' UBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo. Uthando lwenu luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye uBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Uthando lwakho lulukhanya olungasoze lwavaleleka. Uthando lwakho, njengaloo mthombo wamanzi, luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye luyaqhubeka lukhanyisa iindlela zethu. Khumbula ukuba uBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo, kwaye nathi, simele siphile ngaloo ndlela—ngothando olungagciniyo, ngoxolelo olungapheliyo, nangokholo olomeleleyo. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona kule Sakramente iNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwako konke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenako ukukwamkela ngoku kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngomoya. Ndiyakwamkela njengokuba sele ukhona, kwaye ndizidibanisa nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahlukane nawe. Amen.
closing: Ngamana uThixo onamandla angakusikelela, akugcine, kwaye akukhaphe ngoxolo lwakhe. Hamba noxolo lweNkosi.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBenjamin Vo nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle elukhanyeni lukaKristu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abasentlungwini, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele, abanike amandla, kwaye abaphe ithemba eliqinileyo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Intliziyo yenkosi ifana nomfula esandleni seNkosi; iyayikhokela apho ithanda khona. Zonke iindlela zomntu zinokulunga emehlweni akhe, kodwa yiNkosi evavanya iintliziyo. Ukwenza okulungileyo nokusesikweni kwamkelekile kwiNkosi ngaphezu kwedini. Amehlo azidlayo nentliziyo ekhukhumalayo—ukusebenza kwabangendawo sisono. Iinjongo zomntu okhutheleyo zizisa inzuzo, kodwa ukungxama kukhokelela ekusweleni. Lowo wenza ubutyebi ngolwimi oluxokayo usukela umphunga phezu kwemigibe ebulalayo. Umphefumlo womntu ongendawo unqwenela okubi; ummelwane wakhe akafumani nceba emehlweni akhe. Xa umntu okhukhumalayo esohlwaywa, abangenalwazi baba nobulumko; xa umntu olumkileyo efundiswa, ufumana ulwazi. Olungileyo uqwalasela indlu yomngendawo: kukho lowo uzisa umngendawo ekubhujisweni. Lowo uvalela indlebe yakhe ekukhaleni kwabahluphekileyo naye uya kubiza angaviwa.

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text: R. Khokela mna, Nkosi, endleleni yemithetho yakho. Banoyolo abo indlela yabo ingenabala, abahamba emthethweni weNkosi. R. Khokela mna, Nkosi, endleleni yemithetho yakho. Ndenze ndiqonde indlela yemithetho yakho, ndize ndicamngce ngezenzo zakho ezimangalisayo. R. Khokela mna, Nkosi, endleleni yemithetho yakho. Indlela yenyaniso ndiyikhethile; imithetho yakho ndiyibeke phambi kwam. R. Khokela mna, Nkosi, endleleni yemithetho yakho. Ndinike ukuqonda, ukuze ndiwugcine umthetho wakho, ndiwugcine ngentliziyo yam yonke. R. Khokela mna, Nkosi, endleleni yemithetho yakho. Ndikhokele emkhondweni wemithetho yakho, kuba ndiyayithanda. R. Khokela mna, Nkosi, endleleni yemithetho yakho. Ndiya kuwugcina umthetho wakho ngokuqhubekayo, ngonaphakade kanaphakade. R. Khokela mna, Nkosi, endleleni yemithetho yakho.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Unina kaYesu nabazalwana bakhe beza kuye, kodwa babengakwazi ukumfikela ngenxa yesihlwele. Waxelelwa wathi, 'Unyoko nabazalwana bakho bemi ngaphandle, bafuna ukukubona.' Waphendula wathi kubo, 'Umama wam nabazalwana bam ngabo abaliphulaphulayo ilizwi likaThixo, baze balenze.'

day: Tuesday of the Twenty-fifth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm
